findings.highlight: the sound of footsteps
findings.evidenceJa: 板張りの廊下を進む足音
findings.governingReading: Footsteps advancing along the wooden-floored hallway wake Shirou.
findings.explanation: The English removes both movement through the hall and the wooden surface that makes the sound legible.

findings.highlight: I wake up my dozing mind
findings.evidenceJa: まどろんでいた意識を起こす
findings.governingReading: Shirou rouses his drowsing consciousness after the footsteps wake him.
findings.explanation: The English uses an unnatural construction and blurs the distinction between bodily waking and gathering awareness.

findings.highlight: It’s not that I know who’s there
findings.evidenceJa: 何も気配を感じ取った訳じゃない
findings.governingReading: Shirou has not sensed any presence; calling Sakura is only vague intuition.
findings.explanation: The English changes absence of supernatural or sensory detection into uncertainty about the person’s identity.

findings.highlight: The door opens
findings.evidenceJa: 襖が開く
findings.governingReading: The room’s fusuma sliding door opens.
findings.explanation: The English removes the specific architectural object.

findings.highlight: Sakura steps through into my room
findings.evidenceJa: 戸惑いがちに襖を開けて
findings.governingReading: Sakura opens the fusuma hesitantly before entering Shirou’s room.
findings.explanation: The English preserves entry but removes her hesitant manner and her act of opening the door.

findings.highlight: Sakura apologizes
findings.evidenceJa: 自分を責めるように桜は謝ってくる
findings.governingReading: Sakura apologizes in a manner that sounds as though she is blaming herself.
findings.explanation: The English removes the self-accusatory quality of her apology.

findings.highlight: the pain she has to go through
findings.evidenceJa: 渇きに喘ぐ身体の苦しみ
findings.governingReading: Shirou knows intimately the bodily agony of gasping with thirst.
findings.explanation: The English reduces the embodied thirst and respiratory image to generic suffering.

findings.highlight: I forgot about Sakura
findings.evidenceJa: 桜の体質を失念していた
findings.governingReading: Distracted by his left arm, Shirou forgot Sakura’s bodily condition and recurring need.
findings.explanation: The English makes it sound as though he forgot Sakura herself.

findings.highlight: the act of sucking blood
findings.evidenceJa: “血を飲む”という行為
findings.governingReading: Shirou wonders whether the act of drinking blood feels morally taboo to Sakura.
findings.explanation: The English changes the action to sucking, adding a more specific physical and sensual mechanism.

findings.highlight: somehow indecent
findings.evidenceJa: 背徳的な趣き
findings.governingReading: He speculates that blood drinking carries an air of transgression or moral taboo for Sakura.
findings.explanation: The English narrows the broader moral violation to indecency.

findings.highlight: tried to move my left arm
findings.evidenceJa: 無意識に左手を動かしてしまった
findings.governingReading: Shirou unconsciously moves his left hand.
findings.explanation: The English changes the hand to the whole arm and adds attempted rather than actual movement.

findings.highlight: a syringe or something
findings.evidenceJa: 注射針やチューブ
findings.governingReading: A needle and tube would provide the ideal controlled means of transferring blood.
findings.explanation: The English generalizes away the tube and changes needle to the broader syringe.

findings.highlight: There’s still time, it says
findings.evidenceJa: まだ間に合う、と
findings.governingReading: The coercive thought “there is still time” arises within Shirou’s fixation.
findings.explanation: The English attributes the thought to an unidentified speaking entity.

findings.highlight: I don’t need this arm
findings.evidenceJa: その腕は俺には過剰な代物だ
findings.governingReading: The arm is an excessive thing beyond what Shirou can safely contain.
findings.explanation: The English changes dangerous excess and mismatch into simple lack of need.

findings.highlight: You’ll waste your life on sealing that invasive thing away
findings.evidenceJa: 己の一生はそれに侵され、封じることに費やされる
findings.governingReading: His whole life will be invaded by the arm and spent keeping it sealed.
findings.explanation: The English adds the evaluative claim that this life is wasted and weakens the parallel invasion/sealing structure.

findings.highlight: Even just its timer will be enough, so gouge it out with this box cutter
findings.evidenceJa: その時限回路だけでもいいから、このカッターナイフでえぐり出せ
findings.governingReading: The intrusive reasoning urges him to gouge out at least the timed activation circuit with the utility knife.
findings.explanation: The English changes circuit to timer and produces a malformed relation in which the timer itself “will be enough.”

findings.highlight: The blood flows more quickly than I’d thought
findings.evidenceJa: 思ったより景気よく血が出てくる
findings.governingReading: Blood emerges more freely or abundantly than Shirou expected.
findings.explanation: The English changes volume and vigor into speed.

findings.highlight: She goes limp as thought her fright until now had been just an act
findings.evidenceJa: さっきまで怯えていた桜から嘘みたいに力が抜けている
findings.governingReading: Strength leaves Sakura so suddenly that it seems unbelievable compared with her fear moments earlier.
findings.explanation: The English makes the earlier fear sound deliberately performed and also contains a visible “as thought” error.

findings.highlight: move greedily
findings.evidenceJa: 物欲しげに動く
findings.governingReading: Sakura’s half-open lips and pale throat move with visible longing or want.
findings.explanation: The English moralizes the bodily desire as greed.

findings.highlight: as if some sleek beast has taken Sakura’s form
findings.evidenceJa: 桜の姿をした、しなやかな獣のようだった
findings.governingReading: Sakura herself appears like a supple beast while retaining her own form.
findings.explanation: The English suggests a separate beast has assumed Sakura’s form, introducing possession or replacement.

findings.highlight: It dribbles between her soft, wet lips
findings.evidenceJa: 濡れて柔らかそうな唇に滴る血
findings.governingReading: Blood drips onto Sakura’s moist, soft-looking lips.
findings.explanation: The English changes surface contact into blood passing between her lips.

findings.highlight: the softness of Sakura’s tongue at my arm
findings.evidenceJa: 桜の舌が俺の指に触れる滑らかさ
findings.governingReading: Shirou feels the smoothness of Sakura’s tongue touching his fingers.
findings.explanation: The English changes smoothness to softness and moves contact from fingers to arm.

findings.highlight: That indescribably pleasant feeling
findings.evidenceJa: カタチが保てなくなる快感
findings.governingReading: The pleasure makes Shirou feel unable to maintain his bodily form.
findings.explanation: The English removes the dissolution image and replaces it with generic indescribability.

findings.highlight: All the strength goes out of my shoulders
findings.evidenceJa: 肩に力が入らなくなって、外れそうになる
findings.governingReading: His shoulder loses strength and feels on the verge of coming out of joint.
findings.explanation: The English pluralizes the shoulder and omits the near-dislocation sensation.

findings.highlight: I can barely feel my right arm anymore
findings.evidenceJa: 右腕がどうなっているのかもあやふやになる
findings.governingReading: Shirou becomes unsure what is happening to or what state his right arm is in.
findings.explanation: The English narrows broad bodily uncertainty into reduced sensation.

findings.highlight: My left arm is filled with pain and fear, while my right is filled with pleasure and loss
findings.evidenceJa: 左手は苦痛と恐怖に、右手は快感と喪失に
findings.governingReading: The climax explicitly contrasts the left hand’s pain and fear with the right hand’s pleasure and loss.
findings.explanation: The English expands the left hand into the arm and leaves the right member grammatically implicit.

findings.highlight: I embrace Sakura
findings.evidenceJa: 知らずに、桜を抱き寄せていた
findings.governingReading: Shirou realizes he has drawn Sakura into an embrace without consciously deciding to.
findings.explanation: The English turns the involuntary action into a plain deliberate present-tense act.

findings.highlight: The pleasure of the honey being sucked intoxicates me more than Sakura’s soft body, or the feeling of her lips at my arm
findings.evidenceJa: 腕に触る唇と、吸われていく蜜の快感に酔っている
findings.governingReading: The lips on his arm and the honeylike pleasure of being sucked intoxicate Shirou more than Sakura’s soft body does.
findings.explanation: The English coordination places the sensation of her lips alongside her body as something the honey pleasure exceeds, reversing part of the comparison.

findings.highlight: she’s sucking up my energy
findings.evidenceJa: 活力までも吸い上げられていく
findings.governingReading: Shirou feels his vitality or life force being drawn out along with his blood.
findings.explanation: The English generalizes vitality to energy, blurring bodily depletion with the scene’s magical-energy vocabulary.

findings.highlight: I try to see if Sakura is okay
findings.evidenceJa: 桜が無事なのかを、目は確かめようとする
findings.governingReading: Even as his mind floats, Shirou’s eyes independently try to verify Sakura’s safety.
findings.explanation: The English removes the split between failing consciousness and eyes that continue the protective check.

findings.highlight: I can’t think of anything
findings.evidenceJa: 後のことなど考えられない
findings.governingReading: Shirou cannot think about what comes afterward as consciousness shuts down.
findings.explanation: The English broadens temporal inability into total absence of thought.

findings.highlight: My tired body
findings.evidenceJa: 心底疲れ切った身体
findings.governingReading: His body is exhausted to its core.
findings.explanation: The English weakens extreme total exhaustion to ordinary tiredness.
